name: Buenache de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Buenache de la Sierra (a tree, a cross and a hammer on yellow within a bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Buenache de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Buenache de la Sierra arms — tree, cross and hammer within a bordure
